v0.1 · First Light

MULTIVIEW MYSTERY

Start with one view.

  1. Explore: turn the model, then choose a straight-on view.
  2. Predict: choose the drawing that matches the named view.
  3. Build: add cubes on the base or on a cube face. Remove a cube by selecting Remove, then clicking it.
  4. Check: match all three drawings. Use the feedback to decide what to change.

Drag to rotate in any tool. A short click places or removes one cube. You can also use the Column, Height, and Depth controls to build without clicking the model.

Column 1 is left, Height 1 is the bottom, and Depth 1 is the back row. The FRONT label stays attached to the base.

The drawings show the outside outline and visible changes in surface depth. Dashed hidden edges are not required in these challenges. Different models are accepted when they match all three drawings and the build rules.

Build rules: stay inside the 4 × 4 × 4 space. Make one connected model resting on the base. Every upper cube needs a cube directly below it.

Arrow keys rotate the model; + and − zoom. Your progress stays in this tab while it is open.
